records.question: Can a 17 year old ride with Lyft?
records.text:
[Lyft – Eligibility] states that minors who are 16-17 years old may become Users under certain conditions, specifically for Lyft Services (Bikes and Scooters). However, it does not explicitly state that a 17-year-old can ride with Lyft. [Lyft – Eligibility] also mentions that a parent or legal guardian can create a User account for a 13-17 year old minor to use Rideshare Services as a Rider, but it does not directly answer the question. 

However, [10] states that providing Rideshare Services to unapproved, unaccompanied minors under the age of 18 is prohibited, which implies that a 17-year-old can ride with Lyft, but only if they are approved and accompanied.

records.question: Will my paid Zoom plan keep billing me automatically?
records.text:
[Zoom – Effective Date: August 11, 2023] states that you acknowledge that you will only create an account or otherwise use the Services and Software if you agree to be legally bound by all terms and conditions herein, including those in Section 12, which deals with Payments and Charges. 

However, [Zoom – 12. PAYMENTS AND CHARGES] states that in accordance with applicable Law and the terms of this Agreement, Zoom reserves the right to charge you for any updates to the Services or for any premium features or functionality. 

But [Zoom – 12. PAYMENTS AND CHARGES] states that unless otherwise expressly specified in an Order Form, all Charges are exclusive of Taxes and Fees, and that you agree to permit Zoom to use any updated Payment Method to charge you for Charges. 

[Zoom – Effective Date: August 11, 2023] states that you may only use the Services and Software in accordance with the terms and subject to the conditions of this Agreement, which includes Section 12. 

[Zoom – 12. PAYMENTS AND CHARGES] also states that Zoom will provide, at no additional costs, standard updates to the Services and Software that are made generally available by Zoom to similarly situated customers in the same geographic region during the Initial Subscription Term or any applicable Renewal Term. 

However, [Zoom – 12. PAYMENTS AND CHARGES] states that you agree to promptly update your Payment Method to allow for timely payment, and that changes made to your Payment Method will not affect Charges that Zoom submits to your chosen Payment Method before Zoom could reasonably act on your changes. 

[Zoom – 12. PAYMENTS AND CHARGES] states that if any failure to pay Charges continues for five (5) calendar days following the due date, Zoom may terminate, suspend, or disconnect your Services immediately and without prior notice. 

But [Zoom – 12. PAYMENTS AND CHARGES] states that you agree to permit Zoom to use any updated Payment Method to charge you for Charges. 

Therefore, it appears that your paid Zoom plan will continue to bill you automatically, unless you update your Payment Method or terminate your Services.
